changelog: Added DM Campaigns: AI-qualified lead outreach with human-approved sending. New endpoints: POST /dm-campaigns (create from an ideal-customer prompt plus lead sources), GET /dm-campaigns, GET /dm-campaigns/{id}, POST /dm-campaigns/{id}/discover, GET /dm-campaigns/{id}/leads, PATCH /dm-campaigns/{id}/leads/{id} (approve/skip/edit), GET /dm-campaigns/{id}/inbox. Discovery finds and scores X profiles against the ICP, drafts a personalized DM per lead, and a human approves before a rate-limited drip send. Opt-outs are auto-suppressed. Advanced and Agency plans only. Includes a human-in-the-loop workflow and no-bulk-blast guardrails.
